items.title: The Neuron Academy launches 'Office Hours' live AI demo series
points: New live series called 'Office Hours' will show how AI workflows are built from start to finish, not just the polished final results.
First session covers building an interactive diagram using Google AI Studio (a Google platform for building and testing AI models/apps), with step-by-step decision-making shown throughout.
Readers are invited to suggest topics for future Office Hours sessions.

issues.subject: Office Hours (AI edition) are in session 🤖

headlines: The Neuron Academy is launching 'Office Hours,' a new series of live demonstrations showing how AI workflows are built from start to finish, not just polished final results.
